desc: Implement row/column grouping with sorted coordinates and mappings from each house to its index in both groups.
Implement DSU successor lookup and deletion so each house is iterated only once globally.
Implement inclusive binary-search range logic for left/right/up/down movements.
Implement input parsing, movement simulation, final-coordinate calculation, and output formatting.
Verify repeated visits, endpoint houses, empty groups/ranges, movement reversals, and 64-bit-scale coordinates.
